content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for KGMU Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: kgmcindia.edu. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 25-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the KGMU Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the KGMU Senior Resident posts is 25th September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the age limit for the KGMU Senior Resident recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Resident posts is 45 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per the Uttar Pradesh Government rules for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required for the KGMU Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.D./M.S./DNB qualification recognized by the MCI/NMC to be eligible for the Senior Resident posts at KGMU.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for Senior Resident posts at KGMU?
faq.answer: There are a total of 17 vacancies for Senior Resident (Un-registered) posts at King George Medical University (KGMU). These vacancies are distributed across different specializations.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for KGMU Senior Resident recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee for Unreserved (UR) and OBC category candidates is Rs. 3,000/-, while for SC and ST category candidates, it is Rs. 2,000/-.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for KGMU Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The selection of candidates for the Senior Resident posts at KGMU will be based on a Walk-in-interview. Candidates need to attend the interview on the specified date.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for KGMU Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The application process for the KGMU Senior Resident posts is offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official website and submit it to the Medical Superintendent's office.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for KGMU Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The salary for the Senior Resident posts at KGMU will be as per the University rules. Specific details regarding the salary structure can be found in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the walk-in-interview for KGMU Senior Resident posts be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in-interview for the KGMU Senior Resident posts will be conducted at King George Medical University, Lucknow. The exact venue details will be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required to be submitted with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates need to submit self-certified copies of required documents, including educational certificates, experience certificates, caste certificates, and other relevant documents as mentioned in the official notification, along with the application form.
